Package gui

Class OrderHistory_GUI

java.lang.Object
gui.OrderHistory_GUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class OrderHistory_GUI extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller for viewing User History. Separated into two tabs: 1. Order History: All reservation attempts (Completed, Canceled, No-Show). 2. Visit History: Only successful visits with bill and table details.
